skills.description: When a restaurant, cafe, or bar wants to audit how it shows up for local diners — local-pack rank for its cuisine/city queries, review themes, and recent social buzz (TikTok) about the venue and its category. Also use on "are we in the map pack for [cuisine] near me," "restaurant reviews," "why aren't we showing up for dinner near me," "what are people saying about us," "is our restaurant trending on TikTok," or "restaurant local marketing." Reads public listing and social data only — marketing research, not listing or reservation management.
headings: Output: Local Buzz Index + three legs
skills.description_zh: 审计餐厅、咖啡馆或酒吧的本地菜系城市查询排名、评论主题及TikTok近期热度；只读公开商户和社交营销研究，不管理商户信息或预订。

skills.name: keyword-research
skills.description: When the user wants to research keywords, find keyword opportunities, run a keyword gap analysis, build topic clusters, or compare what competitors rank for. Also use on "keyword research," "keyword gaps," "what should I target," "competitor keywords," "search volume," "keyword difficulty," "keyword opportunities," "long-tail keywords," "topic clusters," "what keywords am I missing," or "find keywords for my niche." For diagnosing an existing site, see the seo-audit skill. For structured data, see the schema skill.
skills.description_zh: 研究关键词机会、竞争排名及词汇缺口，建立主题群并分析搜索量、难度和长尾词；既有网站诊断及结构化标记另用专项技能。

skills.name: schema
skills.description: When the user wants to add, fix, or optimize schema markup and structured data on their site. Also use when the user mentions "schema markup," "structured data," "JSON-LD," "rich snippets," "schema.org," "FAQ schema," "product schema," "review schema," "breadcrumb schema," "Google rich results," "knowledge panel," "star ratings in search," or "add structured data." Use this whenever someone wants their pages to show enhanced results in Google. For broader SEO issues, see the seo-audit skill.
skills.description_zh: 为网站添加、修复或优化schema标记和结构化数据，涵盖JSON-LD、FAQ、产品、评论、面包屑及Google增强结果和知识面板需求；广泛SEO问题另用审计技能。

skills.name: seo-audit
skills.description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," "indexing issues," "backlink audit," "toxic links," or "link gap." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For keyword and competitor gaps, see the keyword-research skill. For structured data, see the schema skill.
headings: The 5 Pillars (audit in this priority order)
skills.description_zh: 审计诊断网站技术及页面SEO、元标签、排名流量下降、速度、Core Web Vitals、抓取索引、外链及有害链接或链接缺口；关键词竞争缺口及结构化数据另用专项技能。

skills.name: seo-fix-plan
skills.description: When the user has SEO audit evidence and wants a concrete, prioritized plan for what to fix next. Also use on "SEO fixes," "SEO fix plan," "technical SEO fixes," "on-page fix list," "prioritize SEO issues," "turn this SEO audit into tasks," "SEO remediation plan," or "what should I fix first for SEO." For diagnosing issues from scratch, run seo-audit first; for schema implementation details, see schema.
skills.description_zh: 根据已有SEO审计证据形成具体且按优先级排序的修复计划，把问题转成任务；从零诊断先审计，schema实现另用专项技能。

skills.name: reddit-community-research
skills.description: When the user wants to understand the Reddit communities around a niche — which subreddits matter, what questions and objections keep coming up, and the exact language people use. Also use on "Reddit research," "subreddit research," "where does my audience hang out on Reddit," "community research," "what do people ask on Reddit about X," "Reddit objections," "voice of customer from Reddit," "find relevant subreddits," or "outreach-safe threads." Outputs a community research brief from public posts and comments. Reads public Reddit only — never posts, comments, or DMs. For multi-platform brand monitoring, see social-listening-brief.
skills.description_zh: 从公开Reddit帖子和评论研究细分领域的重要社区、重复问题、异议及真实受众语言，输出社区研究简报；不发帖、评论或私信，多平台监控另用社交监听。

skills.name: reddit-thread-fit-check
skills.description: When the user wants to decide which Reddit threads are worth replying to, citing, monitoring, or avoiding based on relevance, subreddit rules, conversation intent, and outreach risk. Also use on "Reddit thread fit," "is this Reddit thread safe to reply to," "find outreach-safe Reddit threads," "prioritize Reddit replies," "Reddit participation risk," or "which Reddit posts should we engage." For broader subreddit mapping, run reddit-community-research first.
skills.description_zh: 按相关性、社区规则、对话意图及联系风险评估Reddit讨论是否值得回复、引用、监控或避开，确定参与优先级；广泛社区图谱先用社区研究。

skills.name: social-listening-brief
skills.description: When the user wants to monitor what people are publicly saying about a brand, product, category, or launch across social and news. Also use on "social listening," "brand monitoring," "what are people saying about us," "monitor mentions," "track our launch," "buzz check," "social media monitoring," "are people talking about X," "sentiment on Reddit/X/TikTok," or "what's the chatter." Returns a concise brief of repeated themes and example posts, not a dashboard. Reads public posts only — never posts, replies, or DMs. For deep subreddit mapping, see reddit-community-research.
skills.description_zh: 监控社交和新闻中对品牌、产品、类别或发布的公开讨论，返回重复主题及示例帖的简明报告，支持提及和情绪研究；不制作仪表板，也不发帖、回复或私信。

skills.name: buying-signal-monitor
skills.description: When a seller or SDR wants to catch public buying intent on X/Twitter and LinkedIn — someone asking for a tool they sell, complaining about or switching off a competitor, or hiring for a role that implies a need. Also use on "buying signals," "intent signals," "social listening for sales," "warm leads," "who's looking for a tool like ours," "people switching vendors," "hiring signal," "trigger event," "find prospects on Twitter/LinkedIn," or "monitor for sales triggers." Reads public posts only — read-only research; the operator sends from their own accounts.
